name: It is the 26
source:
After spending a Christmas alone, Elise woke up next morning and went for a walk.

Now she's back home.

[From [url=https://yohsk13.itch.io/it-is-the-26]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
伊莉丝独自过了圣诞节。第二天早上醒来，她出门散了散步。

现在，她回家了。

（来源：[url=https://yohsk13.itch.io/it-is-the-26]itch.io[/url]）
